Class NativeBattery

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal.NativeBattery

public final class NativeBattery extends Object implements Battery
The M5Stack Cardputer's battery, implemented by compiler intrinsics over M5Cardputer.Power.
